items.prompt:
Read the story.

When the little dog got stuck in the fence, Aiden did not hesitate. He ran over, gently pushed the wire apart, and freed it.

Which word best describes Aiden?
A) Helpful
B) Lazy
C) Rude
D) Sleepy

steps: Aiden "ran over" and "freed" the stuck dog.
Helping the dog shows he is helpful.
The answer is A.

Rina practiced the piano for hours every day because she dreamed of playing at the school concert.

What does Rina want (her motivation)?
A) To sleep more
B) To play at the school concert
C) To quit piano
D) To watch TV
items.answer: B) To play at the school concert

steps: Motivation is what a character wants.
Rina "dreamed of playing at the school concert."
The answer is B.
solution.answer: B) To play at the school concert

items.prompt:

When Deja saw the storm clouds, she quickly pulled the class art inside so the rain would not ruin it.

How does Deja's action affect the story?
A) The art gets rained on
B) The art is saved from the rain
C) The storm stops
D) The class goes home
items.answer: B) The art is saved from the rain

steps: Deja "pulled the class art inside" before the rain.
Her action keeps the art dry.
So the art is saved; the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) The art is saved from the rain

items.prompt:
Read the story.

Tired and cold, Ben still gave his only blanket to his shivering little brother and stayed up feeding the campfire.

Which two words best describe Ben?
A) Selfish and mean
B) Caring and unselfish
C) Lazy and bored
D) Loud and silly

steps: Ben gave away "his only blanket" though he was cold.
He put his brother's comfort first.
That is caring and unselfish, so B.

How does Dana's impatience affect the events?
A) The model turns out perfect
B) It causes the model to fall apart, so she must restart
C) She wins a prize
D) The glue dries faster

Her impatience caused the restart, so B.
solution.answer: B) It causes the model to fall apart, so she must restart

items.prompt:
Read the story.

At first Kwame felt embarrassed about his accent and stayed silent. After a classmate praised how he pronounced Spanish words, he felt proud and started reading aloud in both languages.

How do Kwame's feelings change during the story?
A) From proud to sad
B) From embarrassed to proud
C) From angry to bored
D) They do not change

steps: At first Kwame felt "embarrassed" and "stayed silent."
After the praise he "felt proud" and read aloud.
So his feelings change from embarrassed to proud, B.

items.prompt:
Read the story.

Cautious Nia noticed the ice near the pond looked thin. When her friends dashed toward it to skate, she blocked their path and pointed out the cracks. Grumbling, they skated on the safe rink instead.

How does Nia's cautious nature change what happens?
A) Her friends fall through the ice
B) Her warning keeps her friends off the dangerous ice
C) The pond freezes solid
D) Nobody skates at all
items.answer: B) Her warning keeps her friends off the dangerous ice

steps: Nia is "cautious" and noticed the ice "looked thin."
She "blocked their path" and pointed out the cracks.
Her caution sends them to the safe rink, so B.
solution.answer: B) Her warning keeps her friends off the dangerous ice

items.prompt:
Read the story.

Generous but forgetful, Uncle Leo promised to drive the team to the game, then lost track of time fixing a neighbor's fence. The players waited an hour before another parent finally drove them, arriving just in time for the second half.

Which sentence best explains how Uncle Leo's traits shape the events?
A) His generosity made the team win
B) His forgetfulness delayed the team, but another parent saved the day
C) His fence broke the car
D) The team never made it to the game
items.answer: B) His forgetfulness delayed the team, but another parent saved the day

steps: Leo is "generous but forgetful."
Forgetting the time, he made the players "wait an hour."
Another parent then drove them in time, so B.
solution.answer: B) His forgetfulness delayed the team, but another parent saved the day
